summary: Iteration 15 verification of: editable Reference (PasHub) field, Surveys & Re-extraction control (async re-extract + polling), CPH Design logo in header/login, backend PATCH /reference, POST /documents, POST /reextract, plus pack/dashboard regression. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (incl. a full async re-extract lifecycle run that returned in <1s and cleared the reextracting flag in ~170s with no error). Frontend: full Playwright flow passed — login logo renders (image actually loads, naturalWidth 1029), login works with the admin credentials, header brand-logo renders and navigates home, reference-input is editable and persists via PATCH /projects/{id}/reference (verified after reload, then restored to RTF-2026-0172), reextract-control renders with type select (6 options) + both buttons, 'Re-extract now' issued POST /reextract (HTTP 200, instant), showed the 'Re-extraction started' sonner toast and put both buttons into a disabled/spinner busy state. No ORTHOGRAPH wordmark remains. Pack regression: pack.html 200 with Drawing Register/heritage/junction/panel-count content, pack.pdf 200 valid %PDF >200KB.

minor.issue: Background job state is not durable/reconciled: if the backend process restarts (deploy, hot reload) while the asyncio task is in flight, project.reextracting stays true forever with reextractError=null — nothing ever clears it. Reproduced (uvicorn WatchFiles reload killed an in-flight job; I cleared the stuck flag manually in Mongo). Suggest storing reextractStartedAt and clearing/marking stale flags on startup or treating flags older than N minutes as failed.

Endpoint is not idempotent/guarded — repeated calls while reextracting=true spawn additional concurrent AI jobs (no 409/no-op). Frontend disables the button locally but a second browser tab or direct API call can stack jobs.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded placeholder avatar circle showing initials 'AO' is rendered right after the real UserMenu (which already shows 'DF Dean Foster'), so every user sees a duplicate/incorrect avatar in the header.

integration_issues.issue: Polling lives only in ReextractControl local state — navigating away or reloading during a job loses all progress/completion feedback (no busy indicator on remount even though project.reextracting is true). Consider deriving the busy state from project.reextracting on load.

issues: Redundant 'AO' avatar next to the user menu (see ui_bugs)
CPH Design logo renders quite small (h-8, ~56x36px) in a 1920px header; acceptable but visually lightweight next to the breadcrumb divider

action_items: Add stale-flag reconciliation for reextracting (startup sweep or reextractStartedAt timeout) so a backend restart cannot leave a project permanently 'reextracting'.
Guard POST /projects/{id}/reextract against concurrent runs (return 409 or no-op when already reextracting).
Remove the hardcoded 'AO' avatar div in Shell.jsx TopBar (duplicate of UserMenu avatar).
Optional: initialise ReextractControl busy state from project.reextracting so the spinner survives reload/navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /projects/{id}/reference correctly trims + 422s on empty and 404s on unknown project; response excludes _id. Good.
asyncio.create_task in reextract_project has no reference held and no persistence — task is fire-and-forget; on process exit the DB flag is orphaned (see minor issue).
server.py is ~1500 lines; continues to exceed the 700-line guidance — consider splitting project/pack/document routers.
add_documents zips files/types without validating equal lengths — mismatched lists silently drop files; add a length check with 422.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Temporarily set project 34850d44 ref to TEST_REF_9001 / TEST-UI-REF-01 during tests; restored to RTF-2026-0172 (verified). Cleared one stuck reextracting flag caused by a hot-reload during the UI-triggered job.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://retrofit-pro-2.preview.emergentagent.com, /api prefix, all /api routes behind require_user (login sets httpOnly cookie; POST /api/auth/login returns the user object flat, not nested under 'user'). pytest.ini runs xdist loadscope — do NOT pass -n/-p no:xdist. IMPORTANT: writing files under /app/backend/ triggers uvicorn WatchFiles reload and will kill in-flight background AI jobs (re-extract/import) — write scratch scripts to /tmp instead. Re-extract on project 34850d44 takes ~150-180s end to end; only trigger it once per run. Reference for that project must remain RTF-2026-0172.
rca_of_the_issue: Stuck reextracting flag: POST /reextract sets project.reextracting=true then fires asyncio.create_task(_run_reextract_bg). The clearing update only happens inside that task, so any process restart (deploy or hot reload) drops the task and the flag is never reset — there is no startup reconciliation or timeout. Reproduced by creating a file under /app/backend during an in-flight job; flag remained true with reextractError=null until manually cleared in Mongo.
